article.title: Attempt to commit robbery or dacoity when armed with deadly weapon
article.content: If, at the time of attempting to commit robbery or dacoity, the offender is armed with any deadly weapon, the imprisonment with which such offender shall be punished shall not be less than seven years.
article.html:
312Attempt to commit robbery or dacoity when armed with deadly weapon

Section 312 · Chapter XVII · Of robbery and dacoity

If, at the time of attempting to commit robbery or dacoity, the offender is armed with any deadly weapon, the imprisonment with which such offender shall be punished shall not be less than seven years.
